records.rationale: Full firmware allocation/layout change reviewed: separates runtime, boot-parameter/version and global buffers, adjusts MMU ranges/alignment and cleanup. Omit this physical NPU firmware feature as a unit; keep the entire native layout, parser, allocations and failure cleanup rather than transplanting only its later constraints. No generic allocator or Android module-source interface changes occur in this candidate. Target evidence: separate Intel PCI NPU provider is disabled in the SDK build; Goldfish selects sample neural-network services with locally inspected CPU execution paths. All 22 candidate paths are exact LTS or absent in both trees. This is target-scoped, not a claim about arbitrary future HALs or devices.

proofs.observation: Generic accelerator framework enabled, separate Intel NPU provider disabled.
Separate Intel CPU-integrated PCI NPU provider, requires PCI/MSI and firmware; this is not the generic Android neural-network API.
APEX selects sample-all, sample-limited and sample-shim services.
sample-all builds SampleDriverAidl through defaults; sample-limited links canonical sample driver.
Request execution uses CpuExecutor obtained from driver.
Canonical sample implementation executes using CpuExecutor.

Third service links architecture-selected sample support-library prebuilt. Its source mapping alone is not proof about every instruction of this binary; no runtime test or exhaustive binary analysis claimed.
